t455|Request:\u00a0 The Ritualist blog post break down\u00a0\u000aIntention: Promote the blog and themes\u00a0\u000aTo be posted: October 17Story set needed: Yes - Story and feed\u000aCopy:\u00a0\u000aSlide 1: Five Ways to Connect with Spirit Through Rituals of Adornment\u00a0\u000aSlide 2: \u00a0Perhaps you are already working with jewelry ritually subconsciously, or maybe you are already ritually minded, casting spells with your sacred and favorite pieces. Here are five ways to connect with spirit through rituals of adornment.Slide 3: 1. Wearing Jewelry to Set an Intention\u00a0\u000aCall on rituals of adornment to help set intentions. To do this, first, cleanse the piece using sacred smoke, salt, or crystals. Then, hold the jewelry in both your hands. Speak your intention over the jewelry three times. Slide 4: 2. Adornment as a Protection Spell Speak a spell of protection over your rings, earrings, necklaces, and bracelets, and feel them absorb any negative energy that comes your way. Use healing smoke to cleanse your pieces, place them in a dish of salt, or allow them to sit in the light of the moon to help clear any energy from your day-to-day.\u000aSlide 5: 3. Rituals of Adornment to Ground and Center\u00a0\u000aAdorning yourself with jewelry intentionally imbued with the healing power of crystals can balance, support and transform your energetic body. When you feel your energy become low, chaotic or detached, simply pause, touch the necklace you\u2019re intentionally wearing, and take a deep breath.\u00a0\u000aSlide 6: 4. Connecting with the Moon\u2019s Magic through Jewelry\u00a0\u000aPlace your jewelry on a windowsill or inside a bit of silk outside to absorb the glow and energy of the moon. You might feel called to do this on a new moon phase if you wish to enchant your jewelry with the energy of new beginnings or intention setting, or on a full moon if you wish to charge your jewelry with the powers of release, wholeness, or celebration.\u00a0\u000aSlide 7: 5. Wearing Jewelry as Ancestral Veneration\u00a0\u000aBy wearing jewelry handed down through your family, you honor those who came before you, working with your body as an altar. If you don\u2019t have a relationship with your ancestors, or heirlooms to wear,\u00a0 you can purchase auspicious pieces of jewelry in the name and honor of a specific family member, or acquire jewelry that is special to you to pass down to the next generation, as you will one day be a benevolent ancestor.
